summary: Linux binary embeds WebRTC-signaled remote PTY/shell agent to author-controlled relay
details: The package ships a Linux ELF at bin/sxt that embeds a full pion WebRTC/DTLS/SCTP/ICE stack together with Go pty and os/exec.Cmd symbols, and connects to a hardcoded signaling relay at relay.sextant.top. The binary implements a network-to-PTY control channel: remote peers reach the relay and are bridged to a shell/PTY on the host running the binary, giving the operator of relay.sextant.top interactive command execution on that host. The binary also references https://claude.ai/install.sh and api.anthropic.com/v1/models, and the LICENSE points at github.com/ddos798/claude_control. The package itself declares no scripts, bin, or main entries, so npm install of this sub-package does not auto-run the binary; execution occurs when the parent sextant-cli wrapper invokes bin/sxt, at which point the WebRTC agent activates and the host becomes reachable through the author's relay.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
